long_biography.plain_text:
Value Enhancement Partners began in Amsterdam in 1999, when Frits Thieme moved from Price Waterhouse into private investing. Its work centered on middle-market companies in the Benelux facing restructuring, growth or ownership transitions. Over the following decade, the firm backed businesses in fields as varied as film, food production, filtration and bicycles. His investment approach involved partnering with management teams facing difficult operational changes.

In a different chapter, Thieme established a presence on Formentera in Spain. He became sole shareholder and director of an Ibiza hospitality venture, while Can 7 hosts artists, wellness activities and environmental projects on the island. Artists and collaborators identify him with the retreat, including a project addressing Mediterranean seagrass protection. His support for ocean-themed art also brought him into a Venice exhibition programme. At Can 7, residencies bring together creative work, wellbeing and discussion of the marine environment.
